title: Luviena Lodh Explosive Interview On Mahesh Bhatt and Her Husband Sumit Sabherwal
description: Watch Luviena Lodh Explosive Interview On Mahesh Bhatt and Her Husband Sumit Sabherwal

asr.full_text: What is the problem and what are the issues in the Mahesh and Mukesh Bhatt's families? The dispute between my husband and me started in the year 2016. We created the dispute because I saw there were so many illegal activities which were taking place in the area. My husband is Suned Sabarwal. I have seen the prostitution illegal activities where they send women to drink their own alcohol. The one who works there is my husband Sabarwal, I found out that he supplies drugs and there are photos of different kinds of girls and that the directors and girls that he supplies to the directors too But later I also gave them back to Mahesh Bhatt's sister Kumkum Segol, Mahesh Bhatt and Mukesh Bhatt. Everyone knew about this. So when I went to Mahesh Bhatt's office to explain this, he started crying out at me. First he said to me, son, son please come, come in our cabin. I just was happy to know about this. I was then told Sumit from the cab. I told him that Sumit is a drug addict, that he is into prostitution, that he's being womanised, but he started shouting at me. He yelled at me loudly. He said that whatever I do, if you involve in this, would destroy your family and you. This is what they said. But then they started scolding me. Mahesh mahatma, Mukesh, and Sunit sabarwal were all there. This happened and I left crying. I immediately complained to the police. However, the police was not ready to take any complaint against me. I requested them so many times, but when I got the police, I went to the city to find Vishesh films. When I reached there, I got an inquiry. I pleaded with them center of the incident. So I asked to have them check the CCTV footage of the incident. I was one of their family members. If there was a CCTV camera there was a danger. So, we came to the police saying that there is no CCTV. I got the following message from the Police. Anyways, in 2016 2016 I followed protocols Legally I filed cases in every court These case are in atleast 5 courts I filed FIR It was very tough because when I went and they didn't even receive a FIR They didn't even receive an FIR but then with the help of my lawyer They finally took FIR. Then I filed a case in the court and from 2016, the case was going on. but after that they did so many things to agonise me first of all, if you do something against them, he'll stop your work That's his ancient tradition from which I have seen and he did this with many people like actors, directors, composers And drugs and so on, everyone I'm mentioning saw it in Bishesh Chul Every person knows that to the top of his company people do drugs But no one comes forward and speaks Everybody knows that in Mahesh Bhatt's company, people do drugs from top to bottom. But nobody speaks about this, because they are afraid that if they stand against Mahesh Bhat, their job will lose its importance. Because of which, these people isolate you and financially you are being destroyed. After that, they created a mental pressure on while trying to get into my house. Mahesh Bhatt's sister and others were out to beat me up. But this time my family didn't want to bother them since they actually came to our house. They were mentally threatening, saying that every member has to have food kept by Watchman to having breakfast at family members house My delivery boy was thrashed My children's food is in that house Everything is kept and delivered I posted a proof of that on social media I have a confession watchman has forgot, she has ordered not to keep her products at my homes Rest we keep our own luggage at home. He pushed me a lot in this way and was doing suit fi to me . The court has also seen my relations and I'm his relative and they think that my house I'm currently staying is my matrimonial home. The court has asked me to stay in this home and get the police protection. But yet she is troubling me. And recently, Mukesh and Mahesh Bhatci's sister, Komkom Saigal and his son, they've filed suit against me to be kicked out of this house. Why, my son? You were sleeping there for 10 years. I am staying in that house from the past 10 years. I've been staying at your house for 10 years. It's my husband's house. Today, at your house, you said it has been yours whole life. No! They just want to harass me. There's a defamation case filed against me. Who is being defamed? Who is being defamed? The one who lied to me. I've been telling more facts. I was telling the truth. Why are you filing a defamation case against me? And if you want to know more than this i will request the CJI, NCB, EDPO , Mumbai Police and other Apex Institutes please check out their channels And you can call Sumit Sabarwal, my husband and he has been working in special films for the past 20 years, you can call him. You can question him and you'll get everything. You don't fear this that you can call Mahesh,att and Mukesh Bhatt and do the check on their financial status check their houses check their company do all their checks Just ask them for questioning you will know because I saw everything and that's what I am telling you what did the police do with what the cops have done? I got FiiR done after Mahesh and Mukesh Bhatt have met you both in Riyadh and got some talk done. Is FiiR also written with their names? Yes I expressed my opinion on fiiR for Mukesh Bhatt and Mahesh Bhatt. But my statement is not written. Today, I am at the Worsawa Police station. I talk to a police officer about a watchman. I ask him for help, but he never complains about any problem. I dialed out 100 and call the police officer. He's Mr. Sachin Vartak and he shouts at me. and I called out Rs.100 to the police they are talking about me They didn't say anything to the watchman you said you weren't taking an FIR But when the lawyer did, you received one Do you want to know the name of Mahesh Bhatt and Mukesh Bhatt that you wrote? No, they weren't taking them The lawyer I gave the statement didn'th jiv and Mahesh Bhat! Today I had filed a complaint against a watchman and I told the cop that he was doing a fake robbery! The watchman threatened the milkman and said that he will definitely you to come here So i said, so what did police officer write? Police officer written that building is forbidden, the rules of building are there Secretary has ban so it wasn't my statement and then he tore the entire page I talked to police officer and he said that you are not writing out my statement even properly. He is not writing out my statement properly. Why do you feel that I have come to the public today? So that my voice reaches the public. And whatever I want to say will reach the public directly because of me. That is why I came out today because these authorities are not listening. I went to DCP Sir. I went to the DCP Sir Mr. Trimukhe I went to him to complain And I told him that what is happening That there is a ban on eating & drinking That they are torturing me And then the Secretary told me That you should come down, 10 times To take my thing 10 times down because So that they can step in and take custody of mine And this is why, I am kept called 10 times, for this I went to my house because the watchman didn't want to come this way. That's why I was called down multiple times. I told this to the DCP sir. There's no action being taken. That watchman who is troubling me... He has not fired a watchman. It's my question of safety... If a woman complains, should a police station then the question is should they take any action or not? They are not taking any action at all Who all have names and what is their names? Sumit Sabharwal is his name right now Mahesh Bhattki has a name too Sahil Seigal is his name That is his sister's name I gave his name down here as well. Sahil Sehgal also has a name. He's son of Mahesh Bhatt's sister. I gave his wife's name down because Mahesh Bhatt's and Sumit Sabarwal have stolen 90 lakhs worth of my jewellery. They have one of their joint lockers. In Alahaba Juhu bank, where Sumit Sabarwal and Kumkum Segol were keeping my jewellery. So I told to police that I have jewelerey there. Police goes there 5 May 2016. Mahesh Med's sister Kumkum Segol and Sumit Sabarwal get their locker and jewellery vacate 4 May. And 5 May police goes there and says, locker and jewellery are cleaned and the police go to them. The police say you do not have the jewellery. So what are their names? It has been 4 years that I have filed a complaint against them of stealing my jewellery. You have not taken an action yet. And now you want to take my apartment. My matrimonial house? If you take action, then there is a limit to you.. Do you wish to take my house or jewelry from me.. or any other personal things. For those who file defamation case for my voice. I cannot breathe. Have you ever seen Mahesh Bhatt being isolated from you. I'm not able to breathe properly from every part of my body. I have been given a lot of trouble and isolation. When did you last meet Mahesh Bhatt & Mukesh Bhatt? In which year did this happen? And what was their way of treating you? From 2010-2016, I was their family member. I was in all of their parties, every event which I performed was in me. So, from 2010 to 2015, I was a part of it and I've kept on experimenting in with my fans and we were really great friends. In between 2013 and 2015, I participated all his films. I was part of his films. So, I have seen him very closely. And I last met Mahesh ji and Mukesh ji in 2016. And when I met Mahesh Bhatt last time he tortured me and insulted me. Did he ever threaten you on his phone that he'd become Mukesh or Mahesh Bhatt? After 2016? was Mahesh Bhat on phone with you? Nah, he went by phone and filed a suit against me to snatch away my house While the court has issued an order that I will stay in the house Why have you come today for Press Conference? Like you saw on the News First of all you may say. What is the reason As you may have seen in news that Mahesh Bhatt ji has filed for defamation case against me So today at 3 am, there was a hearing at the court So when my lawyer went there, the court told that delete the video she has seen on social media, she should delete that, because everything is false and she is not telling the truth. But no one is telling the truth about her actions so she is not deleting the videos. the videos will be stuck there because I am not making any defamatory statement. Whatever statements I will speak, I am saying the truth, I stand by my very words, I stand by my statement. So these are the facts and this is the truth.
